fullContentHtml:
📢 UPPSC PCS 2025 Interview Schedule & Mains Result

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC Prayagraj) has published the official Interview Schedule for candidates shortlisted through the Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services (General Recruitment / Special Recruitment) Mains Examination 2025. The interview board sessions will take place between 28 September 2026 and 24 October 2026 at the UPPSC Commission Office, Prayagraj.

📅 Interview Dates & Timings

  • Interview Start Date: 28 September 2026
  • Interview Last Date: 24 October 2026
  • First Session Reporting: 09:00 AM
  • Second Session Reporting: 12:30 PM
  • Venue: UPPSC Office, Kasturba Gandhi Marg, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.

📋 Mandatory Documents for UPPSC Interview

  1. Original and 2 self-attested copies of High School Certificate & Marksheet (for Proof of Age).
  2. Original Intermediate Certificate & Marksheet.
  3. Graduation Degree Certificate and all semester / year marks cards.
  4. Caste / Category Certificate (OBC / SC / ST / EWS) issued on UP state government prescribed format.
  5. Domicile Certificate of Uttar Pradesh (if claiming reservation).
  6. No Objection Certificate (NOC) in original from current employer (for government/PSU employees).
  7. Two passport-size photographs attested by a Gazetted Officer and two unattested photographs.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q1. When will UPPSC PCS 2025 interviews be held?

The interviews will be conducted from 28 September 2026 to 24 October 2026.

Q2. How can I download the UPPSC Interview Schedule PDF?

Download the roll number-wise interview schedule from the direct official link in the Important Links table below or visit uppsc.up.nic.in.

Q3. Where is the UPPSC interview venue?

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission, Kasturba Gandhi Marg, Prayagraj (UP).
